question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The sun was shining bright and __intense__ in the sky.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"intense"** means something that is very strong, extreme, or having a high degree of strength or force. (तीव्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The** intense **heat of the desert made it difficult to travel during the day.
 
 
 
• **"Strong"** refers to having great physical power or force; it can also mean something that is intense or powerful. (मजबूत)
 
 
• **Example: **The **strong** winds caused the trees to sway violently.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"intense"** is **"strong"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Weak** (कमजोर): Lacking physical strength or power.

 
 
• **Example:** The **weak** bridge could not withstand the heavy load.
 
 
 
• **Subtle** (सूक्ष्म): So delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a **subtle** change in her expression that only a few noticed.
 
 
 
• **Mild** (हल्का): Not severe or strong; gentle.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather was** mild** and pleasant, perfect for a walk in the park.
